shellCommands.command: git diff package.json && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -not -path './.git/*' -print && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/
cat next.config.ts components/request-metadata.tsx app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx tsconfig.json; head -50 __agent_eval__/run.mjs; grep -rl -i "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head -30

(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; for i in 1 2; do curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Operations\|Request [0-9a-f-]*\|sample [0-9.]*' | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done; pkill -f "next start" ; git status --short

(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; for i in 1 2; do curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f-]{27}|20[0-9]{2}-[0-9T:.-]+Z|0\.[0-9]{6,}' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done; pkill -f "next start"; git status --short
